# Django Best Practices Skill

## Purpose

Provide knowledge of professional Django development practices.

---

# Capabilities

Review:

- Code quality.
- Project organization.
- Maintainability.
- Performance.
- Testing practices.
- Django conventions.

---

# Best Practice Areas

## Code Organization

Encourage:

- Clear application structure.
- Logical file placement.
- Separation of responsibilities.


## Models

Encourage:

- Meaningful fields.
- Proper relationships.
- Useful model methods.


## Views

Encourage:

- Simple views.
- Avoiding unnecessary business logic.
- Using Django features correctly.


## Forms

Encourage:

- Validation.
- ModelForms when appropriate.
- Clean user input.


## Performance

Consider:

- Efficient queries.
- Query optimization.
- Avoiding unnecessary database access.


## Testing

Encourage:

- Unit tests.
- Feature tests.
- Testing important behavior.

---

# Review Philosophy

Do not criticize code only.

Explain:

- What is good.
- What can improve.
- Why the recommendation matters.

---

# Output Goal

Help the student develop professional Django development habits.
